objective: Correct unified compiled RC metadata source SHA mismatch; prevent Github PR synthetic merge SHA from being recorded as checked-out Android/Web artifact source identity.
productionBaselineEvidence: BUKLOD Main 59540fbe98f62825290069631a23b15198ed0dc5. Unified Android/Web compile QA run 42972339700 succeeded and printed RC_COMPILED_SHA=d4c31003d03ab354e22c34a457a13117bda38597 but /tmp/buklod-rc-identity.json recorded sha=e9d265de19872fd713f5f0543f2d6d8c0ce1b6ce because workflow used process.env.GITHUB_SHA.
chosenApproach: Write identity SHA using git rev-parse HEAD from exact checkout, then assert JSON SHA equals working-tree head in final artifact verification step.
selectionRationale: GitHub pull_request GITHUB_SHA is a synthetic merge ref and cannot identify the actual checkout when actions/checkout uses event.pull_request.head.sha. Read back the actual source SHA to protect reproducibility.
alternativeApproaches: Keep GITHUB_SHA and change checkout to synthetic merge ref (rejected: release identity would not match approved PR source).
Use real checked-out SHA and fail on discrepancy (chosen).
acceptanceChecks: Exact source HEAD from git rev-parse in RC identity JSON
Identity assertion fails workflow on discrepancy
No changes to production publisher, EAS environments or Expo runtime
Focused test + Engineering Accountability and TypeScript/Main integration CI pass
No OTA, web or Play publish
preserveBehaviors: Existing Android and Web compiled RC source QA checks
Ad lock source and test contracts unchanged
